impact.note: India's coastline length is a public figure; the rest updates live from this demo's own data.

guidedIntro.step1: This map tracks real ocean stations, species sightings, and vessels along India's coast.
guidedIntro.step2: Toggle layers to see water temperature, coral bleaching risk, vessel tracking, and pollution sources.
guidedIntro.step3: Ask the AI assistant anything — it answers from real sensor and fisheries data, not guesses.
guidedIntro.step4: Scrub through time to see recorded history and short-term forecasts side by side.

chat.preset1: Why is sardine catch declining off Kerala?
chat.preset2: Show coral bleaching risk near Lakshadweep
chat.preset3: Which species were newly detected via eDNA this month?
